_comment: Task 2b top-up: empty_projector_screen_white_wall only reached 9 images, and blank projector screens and projection walls are a core confusion case, being the hard negative for the useful-text-screen positive class. Synonyms bring that concept to roughly 25-30 images in total.
_label: category=negative_clean, so label 0. New slugs go into data/raw/negative_clean as training negatives. This phase does not run prepare_dataset.
_design: Deliberately carries blank, white and no content, to reduce the chance of pulling in projected images containing slides or text, which would be positives. Manual QC is still required; these are covered by the qc_prefilter scan.

negative_clean.query: white projector screen mounted wall blank
pull down projection screen empty room
